description: Explain a verdict - the evidence and reasoning behind it. Answers without an API key. Example call: {"skill":"explain","input":"example.com"}

input.description: The indicator to look up: a domain, an IP address, an ASN or a file hash. The example passes example.com.

name: whisper_explain

outputSchema.description: A tabular graph answer: the column names, the rows keyed by them, and the cost.

columns.description: The column names, in order. Every row object has exactly these keys, so this is the row shape and reading it is cheaper than inspecting a row.

rows.description: The answers, one object per row, keyed by the column names above. An empty array means the question was understood and nothing matched, which is an answer and not a failure.

title: explain
